title: HCP — List Delegations — payload
description: The request payload of the HCP 2.0-draft-3 List delegations operation (Delegated Authorization Profile, HCP 17.2; `GET /v2/delegations` in HCP 9.2, 9.4.13): a Management Client, acting for the Context Subject or a delegate, lists the delegations it may see. HCP defines no request schema for this operation; the `status` parameter comes from HCP 9.4.13, and the result follows the delegations-result shape HCP publishes for the same draft. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3. Every maxLength, maxItems and maxProperties in this schema is a Trust Tasks framework bound (SPEC §7.3 item 19), not an HCP requirement; so is every minLength or minItems of 1 on a member HCP's own schema allows to be empty.

accessToken.description: The Management Client's HCP access token (HCP 9.3), carried unchanged. HCP's HTTP Binding sends it as a Bearer token; this member carries it in the document. The provider validates it exactly as over HTTP and treats it as opaque. The maxLength is a framework bound, not an HCP requirement. OPTIONAL: where it is absent, the provider authenticates the request's `issuer` VID, by the REQUIRED request proof, as a Management Client the Authorizing Principal enrolled (HCP 3.2.3), and refuses any other issuer with permissionDenied; where it is present, the token rules apply unchanged. Pending HCP confirmation (question 56).

status.description: HCP query parameter `status` (HCP 9.4.13), whose one defined value is `ended`. Absent returns only the delegations that hold; `ended` returns the delegations that have ended as well as those that hold ("with ended ones where `status=ended` is asked", HCP 9.4.13), pending HCP confirmation (question 31).

Response.title: HCP — List Delegations — response payload
Response.description: The delegations the caller may see (HCP 9.4.13, 17.2). Not paginated (HCP 9.4.13). Failures use trust-task-error, not this shape.

delegations.description: HCP `delegations` (HCP 9.4.13): every delegation for the Context Subject, for a Management Client acting for them; the delegations naming the delegate, and the sub-delegations that delegate appointed (pending HCP confirmation, question 32), for one acting for a delegate. An ended delegation carries `ended` (HCP 17.2, 17.6). Empty when there are none.
